Apple Watch Ultra provides more ways to customize watch faces than the Series models, including Ultra-exclusive watch faces, colors and fonts, as well as complications for bezel types. The Apple Watch Ultra 4 takes this a step further by adding new options to the bezel configuration category.

Readiness is a new bezel option for the Apple Watch Ultra 4

Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 have simultaneously introduced a brand new Readiness app. This app uses data such as fitness activity, vital signs and sleep scores to calculate a readiness score for you.

Nighttime vital signs include heart rate, respiratory rate, wrist temperature and recovery heart rate variability (HRV). Daytime vital signs include heart rate and recovery heart rate variability.

The Apple Watch Ultra 4 watch face that supports displaying bezel information has added Readiness as a new watch face configuration option. Bezel options now include:

  • None
  • Seconds
  • Depth
  • Elevation
  • Workout
  • Readiness

The Readiness bezel option will place your numerical score and description at the bottom of the watch face.

Four bars wrap around the edge of the watch face, displaying different readiness score categories, while the dots indicate where your score falls within that category.

Watch faces such as Modular Ultra and the all-new Siri Modular watch face support displaying bezel configurations.

If you're looking for a way to focus on your readiness score, this new bezel configuration is a great way to continuously track this number.

Since readiness can fluctuate throughout the day, for many users it may be worth placing it in the most prominent position.

Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 are now on sale.
